title: A sleeker dark-first look (with a light scheme), to join the skin menu
question: Round two: sleek and dark-first. Each look also has a light scheme. Pick one and I build it as a new skin in the Look menu, in BETA only.

options.label: Edge-lit Glass Shelf
options.thesis: Dark glass panels, each lit from its top edge by one hairline of its company's colour.
options.viewport: Slim hairline rail, near-black ground, two glass panels with a coloured top edge fading down. Light scheme: frosted white glass on pale grey, ink hairlines, the same coloured edge.
options.risk: Glass can turn muddy if the panel fills are not held very quiet; contrast must stay high.

raised.raise: Only the selected company and row show full colour; everything else rests in white hairlines on black.
Data freshness is drawn as line form, not colour: solid when live, dashed while pending, half-height when stale.
Rank is carried by weight and case on a tight type scale, not by extra colours or boxes.
A returned or cancelled line is stamped and kept in the list, never removed.

options.label: White City at Night
options.lineage: Tel Aviv Bauhaus facades under street lamps
options.thesis: A cool blue-black city with one sodium-amber lamp marking today wherever it appears.
options.viewport: Deep blue-black shell with balcony-rail hairlines in panel headers; geometric type; today's bar, row and figure are the amber lamp. Light scheme: white-washed facade ground, slate ink, amber lamp kept.
options.risk: Dark with a bright accent is the common look; it holds only if amber stays reserved for today.

options.label: Graphite Console
options.thesis: Graphite panels split by one-pixel seams, with state-only accent colours and monospaced figures.
options.viewport: Tiled panels that persist while pages change; compact sans labels, monospaced numbers, one accent per state. Light scheme: warm-white panels, grey seams, the same accents darkened.
options.case: Holds clarity: it is the proven way to make a dense dark screen scannable. Identification is thin, since it speaks to developers more than to a trading team.
options.risk: Reads as a developer tool, so it can feel cold and generic here.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.case: Fuses poorly: replacing names with coded colour strips hides what the numbers belong to.
options.kept: Only the selected item decodes to full colour.

options.label: Emission Line Rail
options.case: Fuses poorly: colour only as hairlines would flatten charts people read in colour.
options.kept: State carried in line form: solid, dashed, half-height.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.case: Fuses poorly: a raked goldenrod rack is the opposite of sleek and hides the grid.
options.kept: Rank carried by weight and case on one type scale.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.case: Fuses poorly: tear-off coupons are a costume of paper on a working screen.
options.kept: Cancelled lines are stamped and kept, never removed.

canonCard.label: The category standard (dark)
canonCard.thesis: A clean dark analytics dashboard: slate cards, one blue accent.
canonCard.viewport: Slate sidebar, KPI cards on a deep navy ground, standard charts and tables. Light scheme: white cards on light grey.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
